title: AISEO-VirtualabDigital/mcp-video-editor
summary: Wag na kayo magbayad ng 5k PHP. Ito na — libre. MCP server for CapCut + OpenCut from Cursor, Claude, Codex, Antigravity, OpenCode, KiloCode, Qwen Code and ZCode. 59 tools: timeline editing, effects catalog, voiceover (OpenAI/ElevenLabs), Remotion/HyperFrames render. Premiere/Filmora export is BETA and untested. Dry-run safe.
